description:
Reactive extensions for Beckhoff.TwinCAT.AdsClient
			Extends the AdsClient object with Reactive Interfaces for ADS Notifications to support observable Streams of
			value changes.
releaseNotes:
### 7.0.276
Enh: Added mode-specific sampling managers (RawSamplingManager, RawFixedBufferSamplingManager, ValueSamplingManager, DynamicSamplingManager) for cyclic polling of PLC symbols with configurable trigger, stop, and retrieval filter predicates.
Enh: Added generic TypedSamplingManager<T> (where T : unmanaged) for high-performance, zero-boxing sampling of unmanaged PLC values. Subscribes to ADS notifications directly and reads each payload via MemoryMarshal.Read<T>, returning TypedSampleInfo<T> samples with strongly-typed Func<TypedSampleInfo<T>, bool> trigger/stop/retrieval predicates. Use ValueSamplingManager or DynamicSamplingManager for object/dynamic structured values, and TypedSamplingManager<T> for primitive high-frequency access.
BreakingChange: SampleInfo is now a readonly struct (previously a sealed class) exposing only Value and Timestamp, eliminating per-sample heap allocations on the typed sampling path.
Enh: Factored the shared session lifecycle of RawSamplingManager, RawFixedBufferSamplingManager, ValueSamplingManager, DynamicSamplingManager, and TypedSamplingManager<T> into a common ISamplingManager interface and SamplingManagerBase abstract base class (IsActive, InstancePath, DataType, IsTriggered, StoppedByCondition, Mode, StopSampling, Dispose). Added ISamplingChunkInfo / ISamplingChunkInfo<TSample> implemented by SamplingChunkInfo, RawSamplingChunkInfo, DynamicSamplingChunkInfo, and TypedSamplingChunkInfo<T>, and ISampleInfo (Timestamp) implemented by SampleInfo, RawSampleInfo, DynamicSampleInfo, and TypedSampleInfo<T>.
### 7.0.274
Enh: Added SamplingManager for cyclic polling of PLC symbols with configurable trigger, stop, and retrieval filter predicates. Supports typed sampling (by instance path or IValueSymbol) and raw byte sampling (by IndexGroup/IndexOffset).
Enh: Added generic TypedSamplingManager<T> (where T : unmanaged) for high-performance, zero-boxing sampling of unmanaged PLC values. Subscribes to ADS notifications directly and reads each payload via MemoryMarshal.Read<T>, returning TypedSampleInfo<T> samples with strongly-typed Func<TypedSampleInfo<T>, bool> trigger/stop/retrieval predicates. Use SamplingManager for dynamic/string-filtered or structured values, and TypedSamplingManager<T> for primitive high-frequency access.
BreakingChange: SampleInfo is now a readonly struct (previously a sealed class) exposing only Value and Timestamp, eliminating per-sample heap allocations on the typed sampling path.
Enh: Factored the shared session lifecycle of SamplingManager and TypedSamplingManager<T> into a common ISamplingManager interface and SamplingManagerBase abstract base class (IsActive, InstancePath, DataType, IsTriggered, StoppedByCondition, Mode, StopSampling, Dispose). TypedSamplingManager<T> additively gains the Mode and StoppedByCondition members. Added ISamplingChunkInfo / ISamplingChunkInfo<TSample> implemented by SamplingChunkInfo, RawSamplingChunkInfo, DynamicSamplingChunkInfo, and TypedSamplingChunkInfo<T>, and ISampleInfo (Timestamp) implemented by SampleInfo, RawSampleInfo, DynamicSampleInfo, and TypedSampleInfo<T>.
### 7.0.272
Enh: Added SamplingManager for cyclic polling of PLC symbols with configurable trigger, stop, and retrieval filter predicates. Supports typed sampling (by instance path or IValueSymbol) and raw byte sampling (by IndexGroup/IndexOffset).
Enh: Added generic TypedSamplingManager<T> (where T : unmanaged) for high-performance, zero-boxing sampling of unmanaged PLC values. Subscribes to ADS notifications directly and reads each payload via MemoryMarshal.Read<T>, returning TypedSampleInfo<T> samples with strongly-typed Func<TypedSampleInfo<T>, bool> trigger/stop/retrieval predicates. Use SamplingManager for dynamic/string-filtered or structured values, and TypedSamplingManager<T> for primitive high-frequency access.
BreakingChange: SampleInfo is now a readonly struct (previously a sealed class) exposing only Value and Timestamp, eliminating per-sample heap allocations on the typed sampling path.
### 7.0.109
Enh: Overall optimizations for performance gains and less memory pressure. More internal usage of ReadOnlyMemory<byte> instead of byte[] reduces the amount of array copy operations.
### 7.0.36
Breaking Change: Removes .NET6 as Dependency (out-of-support)
### 7.0
Enh: Supports **locally** installed TwinCAT 2 (via PInvoke channel)
     Fallback usage of 'TcAmsServer.dll' internally enables function on systems that don't have TCP Loopback port open (e.g TC2 and systems with TCP Loopback disabled), #230847
Enh: Supports internal communication via UnixSockets, TCP/IP Loopback and PInvoke
Enh: TargetFramework dependencies changed to net8.0, net6.0, netstandard2.0
